title: Craft System Construction Product Feature Thesis
problem: Product purpose, domain meaning, architecture, implementation, operation, and evidence are fragmented across tools and handoffs, so systems are constructed and changed without one owner-controlled continuity chain.
value_proposition: Help an owner turn a product feature into a working, explainable system whose implementation traces to its meaning and can change without silently breaking that meaning.
value_mechanism: Bind product context and owner boundaries to typed product, business, and system meaning; select exact architecture and implementation realizations; construct a deterministic contained target; independently observe static and runtime conformance; preserve residue; and route an evidenced successor state to its explicit owner.
boundaries: the Craft Product is the immediate feature context and the CyberAlchemy Product Thesis is its parent context
the Craft Project coordinates development and CAV2-D20 owns the building Method
Product Feature is a project-local candidate term until separately admitted
DomainSpec v2 is the former Product name and its paths remain migration inputs until exact relocation evidence exists
the private Craft Project remains distinct from the public Arcanum craft capability and .craft state
this thesis authorizes no implementation, migration, publication, release, or deployment
hypotheses: stable continuity from product context to runtime reduces system-construction and change burden
exact reusable realizations reduce architecture rediscovery without stealing owner meaning
deterministic construction plus independent observation detects consequential drift before release
typed successor states improve migration, recovery, rollback, and evolution
the modeling and evidence cost is lower than recurring integration and architecture drift
evidence_routes: exact preservation of selected working DomainSpec capabilities
one bounded target system constructed from an owner-selected Craft feature slice
migration, recovery, compensation, and rollback evidence
owner, builder, operator, and reviewer burden observations
counterevidence_routes: continuity modeling costs more than it saves
owners cannot distinguish source meaning from generated projections
exact realization selection blocks necessary adaptation without evidence benefit
construction and conformance repeat the same defects
runtime observations cannot remain bounded and attributable
a simpler feature preserves the same guarantees
owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Craft Project owner

revision_history.change: Created the System Construction Product Feature thesis with the Craft Product Thesis as immediate context and CAV2-D20 as the building Method.
Recorded DomainSpec v2 as the former name of the same Product lineage and preserved its paths as migration inputs.
revision_history.owner_route: Craft Product owner plus Craft Project owner

challenge_route: Challenge Product context and feature meaning through the Craft Product owner, Project coordination through the Craft Project owner, Method meaning through definitions-governance, and inherited DomainSpec meaning through the DomainSpec v2 owner.
claim_ceiling: Draft System Construction Product Feature thesis inside the selected Craft Product context only; not physical or authority migration from legacy DomainSpec-v2 paths, committed direction, canonical Product Feature meaning, ontology admission, architecture selection, implementation, publication, release, deployment, or production authority.
